subject: The live model turn loop -- Odyssey promotion gate G4's central requirement
status: MERGED. Claimed live path proven with a real Llama GGUF. Controller re-run of the live integration test is DEFERRED until the GPU benchmark finishes, to avoid contaminating a measurement in flight.
why_this_gate_mattered: Everything HIDE had wired before this was upstream of the thing that actually produces tokens. The archaeology found HIDE_MODEL_WEIGHTS required for any generation, so the turn loop had never been exercised end to end against a served model. G4 states outright that a stub provider returning canned text fails the gate -- the entire archaeology exists because things looked wired and were not.
live_path_claimed: SubmitTurn intent -> context compile -> RuntimeSupervisor/HttpModelProvider -> canonical SSE model events -> streamed TokenBatch -> persisted agent.message -> next turn rebuild_history sees it
why_the_claim_is_credible_before_i_re_ru: The test is a real integration test (crates/hide-backend/tests/live_model_turn.rs, 524 lines) that stands up a serve process and drives the live intent path, not a unit test on an inner function.
It runs against a real Llama GGUF discovered from the HF cache or HIDE_MODEL_WEIGHTS -- there is no canned provider in the path.
It asserts the round trip completes AND that the next turn's rebuild_history sees the persisted message, which a stub could not fake without also faking persistence.
Runtime ~148s, consistent with real generation rather than a mock.
honest_caveats: The lane could not use Metal -- the executor sandbox has no device -- so the loop runs through the CPU generate fallback. Real tokens, but not the GPU path.
Llama prefill_slot and Qwen GPU batch prefill remain unclosed; both live in hawking-core, which the lane was forbidden to touch. The fallback avoids inventing a stub, which is the right call.

The test skips cleanly when no weights are present or HIDE_LIVE_MODEL_TURN=0. That is correct for CI hygiene but means a green suite does NOT by itself prove the loop ran -- the test must be confirmed to have EXECUTED, not merely passed. That confirmation is what the controller still owes.

test_counts.after_reported: 248 total, 246 passed, 2 pre-existing process/shell env flakes
test_counts.note: The 2 flakes are run_command and service_process timing tests already established as non-reproducing in the controller's environment.

HIDE_KERNEL_TURN: Untouched. Merging a live loop does not pass its promotion gate.
g4_standing: Substantially met on the CPU path. Full green requires the controller to confirm the live test EXECUTED rather than skipped, and ideally a GPU-path run once BASE_RUNTIME_MAXIMIZED work settles the device.
